newsitem.title: USA: U.S. barge rates-Quoted thinly steady to lower.
newsitem.headline: U.S. barge rates-Quoted thinly steady to lower.

text.p: U.S. barge rates were quoted at lightly steady to lower levels on Wednesday on the St. Louis Merchants Exchange call session.
No barges traded versus none on Tuesday.
- Two barges, Illinois River, next week, bid 95 percent of tariff, unchanged from Tuesday, no offer.
- 10 barges, St Paul-Savage upper Mississippi River, two each week of June, bid 135 percent, unchanged from May 23, no offer.
- 18 barges, Mid-Mississippi River, two each week of June and July, no bid, offered 112-1/2 percent, down 2-1/2 percentage points from Tuesday.
